editorial:
Imagine a world of high-fashion runways and dark secrets where things go wrong very quickly. You start the story with a doctor who makes a huge mistake during a procedure on a model. Instead of calling for help, he covers up the death to save his own skin. But here is the catch: someone is watching, and they want revenge. You will feel the tension build as a mysterious killer starts picking off everyone connected to the fashion agency one by one. The vibe is very much like those old-school mystery movies where you are constantly trying to guess who is behind the mask before the next body drops.

What really works here is how the movie keeps you guessing with its twists. The acting is decent for the time, and the pacing stays quick so you never get bored. While some of the special effects look a bit dated, it adds to that retro charm. If you love Giallo style films with bright colors and sudden shocks, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The mystery wraps up when the killer is finally revealed to be someone close to the victims who had a hidden grudge. In the final scenes, the killer tries to finish the job, but a final struggle leads to their death. The movie ends by showing that the cover-up caused more pain than the original accident. You see the survivors left to pick up the pieces after a bloodbath in the fashion world.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 70s Italian thrillers and whodunit mysteries.
similarMovies: The Bird with the Crystal Plumage
